existing_scope_limits: The original Liu main check covers360 strictly positive finite conditional cases plus a one-element point mass; it does not claim to construct operational transitions from zero-mass current categories. The extension now projects to positive support and tests116 input vectors including zero masses and point masses.

The original DHN check covers351 directed and64 grid cases; its positive self-loop establishes aperiodicity only after irreducibility. The extension computes graph periods and tests singleton/redundant/overlapping fibers separately.
The old version-scoped PyMC source negative control was not expanded or run as library code. No unrelated library-runtime investigation was performed.

findings.assessment: For a supported current category with p_a<1, excluded-current proposal and correction multiply to the min-form kernel. Zero conditional categories have zero proposal probability and do not need operational outgoing rows. For p_a=1, staying avoids undefined normalization. Local detailed balance and off-diagonal domination hold on positive support.

findings.source_locator: Neal2004§3PDF5–6 distinguishes local off-diagonal dominance, reversibility and random-scan versus sequential updates. The specific example is original audit reasoning, not claimed to appear in that paper.
findings.assessment: Uniformly randomizing over all coordinate permutations of reversible local kernels yields a reversible sweep because every composition is paired with its adjoint reversed order. That fact alone does not transfer local Peskun domination to the complete sweep. Do not call every random-permutation sweep nonreversible. The draft correctly says the comparison is not automatic.

exact_counterexample.meaning: Local Peskun ordering does not transfer automatically to full sweeps, including reversible uniform random-permutation sweeps. No wall-clock comparison.

findings.assessment: Separate symmetric/involutive MH and sign matrices preserve pi(x)/2^d, so fixed positive mixtures do as well. Singleton lines simply reject the unavailable positional move, then apply sign randomization. One-point spaces and redundant partitions do not invalidate the specified finite construction under interior flip probabilities. Connectivity is a joint property of the union, not a requirement that every partition alone connects X.

Stationarity survives the tested theta endpoints because each stage remains invariant, but irreducibility/aperiodicity can fail. For a uniform n-point line, theta0 creates a deterministic2n-cycle; theta1 leaves closed classes of MH pairs/endpoints. The draft appropriately requires separate endpoint analysis instead of claiming all endpoint choices behave alike.

Set d=1 and choose one ordered line equal to X: each step and sign probability of§5.1 is recovered exactly. Keeping this as a specialization inside the single fiber record is supported. No separate directed record or narrower-name exact alias is needed.

The augmented proposal(x,p)->(x+p|z|,-p) has the same half-normal density as its reverse. Metropolis acceptance followed by unconditional sign negation therefore yields acceptance(y,p), rejection(x,-p) and preserves pi(x)/2. The entire composed kernel need not be reversible merely because its two stages are reversible.

analytic_confirmation.continuous_proposal_density: r_sigma(s)=sqrt(2/pi)/sigma*exp(-s^2/(2 sigma^2)), s>0. q((x,p),(y,-p))=r_sigma(|y-x|) when p(y-x)>0; the reverse proposal has equal density.
analytic_confirmation.exact_density_identity: For A_p(x)=integral_0^infinity r_sigma(s)*min(pi(x-p*s),pi(x)) ds, incoming acceptance density at(x,p) is A_p(x)/2 and incoming rejection density from(x,-p) is[pi(x)-A_p(x)]/2; total pi(x)/2. Assumes proper measurable target density and well-defined finite positive current density, fixed sigma>0. Zero density outside support is included in the integral.

uniform_target_incoming_example.numeric_scope: math.erf floating evaluation only; the displayed analytic identity supplies exact cancellation.

analytic_confirmation.negative_control_distinction: Keeping the old sign on both acceptance and rejection breaks the augmented target in this example. Omitting the final unconditional flip from the equivalent MH-plus-flip representation instead leaves a different valid reversible MH kernel: it is not the same negative control.
analytic_confirmation.nonreversibility_witness: On a positive-density interval, accepted transitions from(x,+) to(y,+), y>x, have positive density but their direct reverse with unchanged plus sign has zero density. The complete guided-walk kernel differs from reversible ordinary MH.
analytic_confirmation.support_note: No reflection, clipping, rejection-resampling or connected-support assumption is needed for the invariance identity. The unbounded half-normal law can jump across zero-density gaps. This calculation does not certify general Harris recurrence, rates or a multivariate bookkeeping implementation.
analytic_confirmation.scale_endpoint: sigma=0 lies outside the draft definition; then y=x and acceptance1 leaves both state/sign unchanged, giving an identity kernel.

findings.assessment: Assume a proper measurable density, a supported current state with well-defined finite positive density and fixed sigma>0. If a proposed point has zero density, it is rejected and the sign flips. This is not reflection or resampling. Invariance does not need connected support; the half-normal displacement is unbounded and can jump zero-density gaps. No counterexample to irreducibility within the complete stated regular domain was established in this audit; do not invent one from disconnected support. The original paper supplies no general continuous ergodicity theorem, and this audit does not add a full Harris-recurrence, rate or multivariate theorem.
rejected_overclaims: Do not transfer DHN finite positivity/connectedness proposition to the continuous method.
Do not treat sigma0 as covered by fixed sigma>0.
Do not assume a state-dependent scale preserves augmented proposal symmetry with the same acceptance ratio.
The projected position process generally retains hidden sign dependence; one-step marginal agreement is not equality of complete Markov chains.
